jobs.description: CompanyThrough its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.Your profile- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.- You have extensive expertise in the design, implementation, and enhancement of Compliance Management Systems (CMS).- You have substantial experience advising on competition and antitrust law matters in an international business context, including cooperation agreements, distribution structures, public tenders, and MundA transactions.- Your expertise covers key compliance areas, including competition law, anti-corruption, data protection and digital regulation, anti-money laundering, and trade compliance.- You combine strong legal and regulatory knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.Your benefitsAt thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.
